# agent/unknown-hook-event

Hook registered under an unknown event.

A hook event name that the agent does not define (a typo such as `PostToolUSe`, or another agent's name such as `beforeShellExecution` in Claude Code settings), in the hook config files each agent documents.

- Default level: `warn`.
- Looks at: each file in scope, on its own.
- References: [CWE-1188](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/1188.html), <https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks>, <https://developers.openai.com/codex/hooks>, <https://cursor.com/docs/reference/hooks>, <https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/reference/hooks-reference>.

## Why it matters

The agent never calls a hook under an unknown event, and it does not say so, so a check that looks installed never runs.

## Flagged

`.claude/settings.json` (warn):

```json
"PostToolUSe": [{ "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "npx prettier --write ." }] }],
```

`.claude/settings.json` (warn):

```json
"beforeShellExecution": [{ "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "echo check" }] }]
```

`.codex/config.toml` (warn):

```toml
[[hooks.Stopp]]
```

`.codex/hooks.json` (warn):

```json
"Notification": [{ "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "notify-send done" }] }]
```

`.cursor/hooks.json` (warn):

```json
"afterFileEdt": [{ "command": "npx prettier --write" }],
```

`.gemini/settings.json` (warn):

```json
"PreToolUse": [{ "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "echo hi" }] }]
```

`.github/hooks/ubon.json` (warn):

```json
"userPromptSubmit": [{ "type": "command", "bash": "./scripts/check-prompt.sh" }],
```

`plugins/formatter/hooks/hooks.json` (warn):

```json
"AfterTool": [{ "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "npx prettier --write" }] }]
```

## Not flagged

- `"PreToolUse": [{ "matcher": "Bash", "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "npx --no-install ubon hook claude PreToolUse" }] }],` in `.claude/settings.json`: a Claude Code event
- `[[hooks.PostToolUse]]` in `.codex/config.toml`: a Codex event
- `"Stop": [{ "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "npx --no-install ubon hook codex Stop" }] }],` in `.codex/hooks.json`: a Codex event
- `"stop": [{ "command": "npx --no-install ubon hook cursor stop" }],` in `.cursor/hooks.json`: a Cursor event
- `"beforeShellExecution": [{ "command": "npx --no-install ubon hook cursor beforeShellExecution" }]` in `.cursor/hooks.json`: a Cursor event
- `"BeforeTool": [{ "matcher": "run_shell_command", "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "npx --no-install ubon hook gemini BeforeTool" }] }],` in `.gemini/settings.json`: a Gemini CLI event
- `"agentStop": [{ "type": "command", "bash": "npx --no-install ubon hook copilot agentStop" }],` in `.github/hooks/ubon.json`: a Copilot event
- `"PreToolUse": [{ "type": "command", "command": "npx --no-install ubon hook copilot PreToolUse" }]` in `.github/hooks/ubon.json`: the PascalCase name Copilot also accepts
- `"PostToolUse": [{ "matcher": "Edit|Write", "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "npx prettier --write" }] }],` in `plugins/formatter/hooks/hooks.json`: a Claude Code event in a Claude Code plugin

## How to fix

Rename the event to one the agent defines; the message suggests the closest name.

## If the finding is wrong

Add a comment on the line above, in the comment syntax of the file, that says who decided and why:

```
ubon-ignore agent/unknown-hook-event: <who decided>: <evidence>
```

Or turn the rule off for the project in `ubon.json`: `"rules": { "agent/unknown-hook-event": "off" }`. See [configuration](../../config.md).
